pending.title: Butterfly Stained Glass Coloring Page | Cathedral Creatures
pending.alt: Half-colored stained glass butterfly coloring page for adults
pending.text: Butterfly of New Life, a stained-glass window from Cathedral Creatures, shown half colored in sapphire, violet and pink so you can see the line art waiting on the other side. The Christian symbol of transformation, one of 40 stained-glass animal designs inspired by Scripture and the medieval bestiary. Single-sided pages for colored pencils and gel pens. Paperback on Amazon.

pending.text: Turtledoves in the Fig Tree, inspired by Song of Songs 2:12-13: a dove among fig leaves and fruit, half colored in luminous blues and greens beside the untouched line art. One of 40 stained-glass animal windows in Cathedral Creatures, an adult coloring book of sacred animals and medieval marvels. Paperback on Amazon.

pending.title: Cross and Roses Church Window Coloring Page for Adults
pending.alt: Half-colored stained glass church window with a gold cross, purple petals and pink roses
pending.text: A church window with a golden cross, violet petals and climbing roses, colored on one side and waiting for your pencils on the other. From Church Windows: 40 original stained-glass window designs, from serene to intricate, with Scripture and reflection pages. A peaceful Christian coloring book for adults. Paperback on Amazon.
